exposure: Antibiotics in the last trimester of pregnancy
antibiotics in the last trimester of pregnancy
outcome: Abundance and diversity of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in the neonatal intestine
cohort: 390 healthy, term-born neonates who did not receive antibiotics
finding: The neonatal intestine harbors a high abundance and variety of ARGs, even in the absence of direct antibiotic exposure, with factors such as delivery mode, gestational age, birth weight, and feeding method influencing ARG abundance.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was associated with the abundance of ARGs in the neonatal intestine.
